facts.headline: Cyclone Alfred's Impact: A Reflection of Global Systemic Vulnerabilities
facts.summary: Cyclone Alfred's landfall across southeast Queensland and northern New South Wales caused flooding, power loss, and economic disruption. Read through collapse, it's less a discrete weather event than a window onto how one storm now propagates through insurance, supply chains, and public finances already under strain.
